author: Nagaram
content:
I and everyone in my IT department agrees that at least dual wielding phones is the ideal setup. I've ran two Pixels for a while just so work stays on one phone and me stays on the other.

Unfortunately my main phone is on contract with Verizon, so I cannot swap to GrapheneOS like I'd like and it's very entertaining to me that I've been looking at getting a third phone to run GrapheneOS and properly de-Google my life by buying a THIRD Google Pixel with Google Fi service.

Does it ever bother you that GrapheneOS basically has to run on a Google device, the enemy number 1 were often trying to hide from?
